# christianbrinkleync.com

> Medicare and insurance help from Christian Brinkley, a licensed insurance agent in Greensboro, North Carolina. Free, no-pressure consultations. Not a call center.

## Who this site serves

- People turning 65 and enrolling in Medicare for the first time
- People already on Medicare reviewing plans during Annual Enrollment (October 15 to December 7)
- Adult children helping a parent with Medicare decisions
- North Carolina residents needing life insurance, long-term care insurance, or retirement income planning

## Key pages

- [Medicare Agent in Greensboro, NC](https://christianbrinkleync.com/medicare-agent-greensboro-nc): Local Medicare help in Greensboro and Guilford County
- [Annual Enrollment Period](https://christianbrinkleync.com/aep): What to review October 15 through December 7
- [Turning 65](https://christianbrinkleync.com/turning-65): Medicare timeline for people approaching 65
- [Medicare Advantage vs Medigap](https://christianbrinkleync.com/advantage-vs-medigap): Plain-English comparison
- [Medicare Questions, Answered](https://christianbrinkleync.com/answers): 20+ articles answering common Medicare questions
- [Life Insurance](https://christianbrinkleync.com/life-insurance): Term and permanent life insurance in North Carolina
- [Book a Free Call](https://christianbrinkleync.com/schedule): Schedule a free consultation
